headline: Executive session on contract negotiations with CEBA and the Supervisors, two AFSCME locals.
summary: City staff asked for an executive session to get guidance on negotiating collective bargaining agreements. The agreements cover two employee groups, CEBA and the Supervisors.
items: Executive session on collective bargaining agreement negotiations with CEBA (AFSCME Local 1373)
Executive session on collective bargaining agreement negotiations with the Supervisors (AFSCME Local 481-07)
location: Council Chambers, City Hall, second floor

CITY COUNCIL WORKSHOP

Contract Negotiations 
November 23, 2026 at 5:00 PM in Council Chambers 
 
REMOTE PARTICIPATION:  
The City Council will conduct this meeting from Council Chambers, located on the second floor of City Hall. If 
you are not able to attend live in person, a recording will be available in the Agenda Center following the 
meeting. 
 
https://portlandme.portal.civicclerk.com/event/9771/files 
 
EXECUTIVE SESSION: 
  
  
 
In accordance with 1 M.R.S. section 405(6)(D), City staff request that an Executive Session be 
held to discuss and receive guidance on the City's negotiation of collective bargaining 
agreements with the City Employees' Benefit Association, AFSCME Local 1373 (CEBA) and 
the Supervisors, AFSCME Local 481-07.
